messages:
Rafi (Design): dropping new mocks for the latency panel — goal: make the scrubber keyboard-first, keep the p95 metric pinned while scrubbing, and surface an inline "sampled" indicator (not just color changes). figma: https://figma.com/... :sparkles:
Nina (PM): nice. quick product Q: when do we auto-apply sampling? threshold still 24h / 1M rows? and should we surface that in the header or inline only?
Dev (Frontend): threshold yes. UX preference: show a subtle banner above chart when sampling is active, and keep the p95 pill visually prominent with a tiny `sampled` tag. tech note: scrubbing fires queries; recommend client debounce 150ms and don't re-fetch full series for sub-500ms scrubs. example: `fetchHeatmap({start,end,sample:0.1,debounce:150})`
Ops (SRE): +1 on debounce. also watch bucket boundary oscillation — suggest a client smoothing of 1.5s for the live p95 render, but keep raw numbers accessible via an "exact" toggle in the chart menu.
Ava (A11y): a11y checklist:
- scrubber must be focusable and use role=\"slider\"; keyboard: arrow keys = 1 tick, shift+arrow = 10 ticks, pageup/pagedown jumps to presets. aria-valuetext should be: "Range start 12:10, end 12:40"
- when sampling toggles, fire aria-live="polite": "Sampling on: results may be approximate"
- ensure p95 pill gets a focus ring and when focused announce "p95: 243ms, sampled"
- heatmap palette: recommend switching to a perceptually uniform sequential palette (Viridis) or adding dot-hatching layer option for colorblind users
Rafi (Design): for microcopy i'm leaning to short labels: "Sample rate" and tooltip text: "Applied to large ranges to limit query cost; may be approximate." thoughts? also considering a tiny info icon next to sampling that links to docs.
Nina (PM): prefer shorter copy too. docs link sounds good. inline banner copy: "Sampling applied — some values may be approximate"
Dev (Frontend): implementation plan: badge is client-only based on `meta.sampled` from the fetch response. we can avoid extra calls by forwarding meta in the heatmap payload. will add keyboard shortcuts per Ava's spec.
Ops (SRE): telemetry ask: emit `viz.sampling_flag` and `viz.p95_sticky_interaction` events so we can trace incidents where sampling hid anomalies.
Ava (A11y): also, ensure the scrubber's live region announces when smoothing is active vs exact view, e.g., "Live preview (smoothed)" or "Exact values"
ui-bot: opened PR #5031: "keyboard-native-scrubber + sampled-badge" and added reviewers @Dev @Ava :robot_face:
Rafi (Design): i've updated the figma to show both the banner and the pill badge. changed heatmap key to include patterned overlay toggle. please review copy in figma (banner + tooltip).
Nina (PM): updated tooltip suggestion: "Sampling reduces query cost for large ranges; results are approximate." shorter and reads better in the UI.
Dev (Frontend): ok locking on debounce=150ms and smoothing=1.5s. i'll add an "Exact" toggle in the chart menu and wire `meta.sampled` through. PR incoming today.
Ops (SRE): will add telemetry events and a dashboard for `viz.sampling_flag` to check whether sampling correlates with missed regressions.
Ava (A11y): i'll test with NVDA + VoiceOver. i'll also validate keyboard order: scrubber -> presets -> banner actions -> sampling control -> p95 pill.
Rafi (Design): thanks all — next steps: Dev implements PR, Ava reviews a11y, Ops wires telemetry, Nina signs off on copy. closing loop in figma later today :heart:
